newsitem.title: USA: Warning flags up at mouth of Houston Ship Channel.
newsitem.headline: Warning flags up at mouth of Houston Ship Channel.

text.p: The U.S. Coast Guard warned commercial ships of floating debris near the mouth of the Houston Ship Channel but said shipping was otherwise unaffected after a fishing boat struck a tanker on Monday.
The tanker was undamaged in the collision but the fishing boat capsized off the east end of Galveston Island in an anchorage area adjacent to the channel, officials said.
"They're still out there upside down, but everybody's getting around them," a Ship Channel Pilots Association dispatcher said of commercial traffic around the accident.
The crew of the fishing boat was rescued safely, a Coast Guard spokesman said.
The Houston Ship Channel connects the Gulf of Mexico to Houston's port and refinery row.
